history.summary: Old (2001) 999-yr 3BR in Hillview D23 at $1.60M / $1,533 PSF — the 9.4%/yr URA rate is built on just 9 transactions and is unreliable, and the technical score is weak (467, losing 215-263-91 record). Quasi-freehold tenure is the main redeeming feature.
history.rating_rationale: 25-year-old development; $1,533 PSF is slightly above the $1,475 URA median. The headline 9.37%/yr appreciation rests on only 9 txns — far below the ~30 needed for confidence — so it cannot be trusted as a forward rate. Hillview MRT is 1.16km (14 min walk), not walkable. Score 467 / Elo 1062 with a clearly losing record. 999-yr tenure and the established Hillview/Bukit Batok nature-fringe lifestyle are the positives, but D23 is OCR with modest appreciation priors and no near-term catalyst.
red_flags: URA rate from only 9 txns — statistically unreliable
Weak technical score and losing arena record
